name: Probability-based Ray Sampling with Quadtree Subdivision
aliases: Fast Learning Radiance Fields by Shooting Much Fewer Rays method
Fast Learning Radiance Fields by Shooting Much Fewer Rays method, Ours
definition: A general framework for accelerating radiance field training that uses context-based probability distribution sampling to shoot rays in complex regions and a quadtree subdivision strategy to refine geometry, reducing training time while maintaining or improving accuracy.
